claim_en: Settled.govt.nz states that an insurer may limit flood-damage cover if a house is in an area that has previously flooded.
quote: has been previously flooded, an insurer may limit any cover for flood damage
source_title: What property buyers need to know about insurance - settled.govt.nz
licence: Copyright Real Estate Authority (not Creative Commons); may be reproduced free of charge for personal or in-house use only
next_step_en: Ask insurers about past claims and flood exclusions before making an offer.

claim_en: The Natural Hazards Commission says LIM reports (Land Information Memorandum) are key documents to seek before an offer, available from the council.
quote: LIM reports (Land Information Memorandum), which can be purchased from the local council
source_title: Before you make an offer on a house - Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake
next_step_en: Ask your lawyer to obtain and review the LIM report and other property documents from the council.

claim_en: Settled.govt.nz says a LIM (Land Information Memorandum) is a report by the local council that summarises the property information it holds.
quote: a summary of the current property information held by the different departments at council
source_title: What is a LIM Report? - settled.govt.nz
licence: Copyright Real Estate Authority (not Creative Commons); may be reproduced free of charge for personal or in-house use only
next_step_en: Ask your lawyer to obtain and review the LIM report and other property documents from the council.

claim_en: Auckland Council says overland flow paths carry water across the ground, and water can build up and enter homes if a path is blocked.
quote: Water can build up and enter homes if an overland flow path is blocked
licence: Copyright Auckland Council; no open licence found
next_step_en: Ask the council or a drainage engineer what the mapped overland flow path means for this property.

claim_en: Auckland Council describes coastal inundation as coastal areas predicted to be covered by sea during large storms.
quote: coastal inundation (coastal areas predicted to be covered by sea during large storms)
source_title: Searching for a home? Here's what you need to look out for
licence: Copyright Auckland Council; no open licence found
next_step_en: Ask the council or your insurer what the coastal inundation mapping means for this property.

claim_en: Auckland Council says its landslide susceptibility ratings are not a measure of risk on individual properties and do not predict if a landslide might happen.
quote: The susceptibility ratings are not a measure of landslide risk on individual properties.
source_title: Understanding Auckland's regional landslide susceptibility maps
licence: Copyright Auckland Council; no open licence found
next_step_en: Check the council property file for geotechnical reports, or ask a geotechnical engineer for site-specific advice.

claim_en: Auckland Council says a LIM report may include information on natural hazards such as erosion, subsidence or slippage, and flooding of any type.
quote: information on natural hazards such as erosion, subsidence or slippage, flooding of any type
source_title: About property files and Land Information Memorandum (LIM) reports
licence: Copyright Auckland Council; no open licence found
next_step_en: Ask your lawyer to obtain and review the LIM report and other property documents from the council.
